title: The First Word
subtitle: requiresStage, and the stage task reading it back
description: The first word of the rite proper, and the college will not hear it
from somebody it has not inducted: `requiresStage: my_pack:inducted`
gates the whole quest on the stage -- per player rather than per
team, so a party's inducted member can read it and their
uninducted teammate cannot, in the same world at the same time.
The stage task inside reads the same flag back: it completes the
moment the player has the stage and is never handed in, because a
flag has nothing to hand. Nothing validates that a stage exists --
a stage exists by being granted -- so a typo here is a quest nobody
can ever open, and the college's handwriting is its own hazard.
